title: Send a little love home
body: Clothes, books or something they left behind. Add your parcel and find a traveller going their way.

title: Your next trip could pay
body: Got room in your bag? Share your route and available space to find parcels you can carry.

title: Find someone heading your way
body: Browse upcoming trips and look for a traveller whose route fits your parcel.

title: Back to campus, bag by bag
body: Sending study notes or a change of clothes? Add the parcel details and choose when it needs to arrive.

title: A safer handover starts here
body: Read the packing guidance and check how handover and delivery codes work before your next parcel.

title: Keep an eye on your parcel
body: Open your activity to review offers, check delivery progress and see what needs your attention.
